name: schematik
description: Search Schematik's public electronics parts catalogue and published hardware build guides for Arduino, ESP32 and Raspberry Pi Pico.

interface.longDescription:
Schematik helps people build electronics projects on Arduino Uno, ESP32 and Raspberry Pi Pico.

Ask about a board, sensor or module to find it in Schematik's public parts catalogue, with its pinout where Schematik has one and a link to the source it came from. Ask for a project idea or a specific build to find published Schematik build guides, then read a guide's parts list, assembly steps, wiring table and complete firmware. Every result links to its page on schematik.io, and each guide has a remix link that opens an editable copy in the Schematik app.

The app is read-only. It does not need an account, cannot see private projects, and cannot order parts, create projects or flash a board; those happen in the Schematik app.
capabilities: Read build guides with wiring and firmware
defaultPrompt: Find a build guide for an ESP32 CO2 monitor.
Which GPIO pins does the Waveshare ESP32-C6 Touch LCD 1.47 use for its display?
I have a Raspberry Pi Pico. What could I build with it?

positive.description: Find a development board in the parts catalogue by brand, chip and screen size. Prompt: "Which Waveshare ESP32-C6 boards with a 1.47-inch touch screen are in the Schematik catalogue?"
positive.prompt: Which Waveshare ESP32-C6 boards with a 1.47-inch touch screen are in the Schematik catalogue?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the Waveshare ESP32-C6-Touch-LCD-1.47 (172×320 touch display, Wi-Fi 6, BLE 5) with a link to https://www.schematik.io/parts/esp32-c6-touch-lcd-1-47. May also mention the non-touch ESP32-C6-LCD-1.47 and say it is not a touch board.

positive.description: Read a board's pinout from the catalogue. Prompt: "Which GPIO pins does the Waveshare ESP32-C6 Touch LCD 1.47 use for its built-in display, according to Schematik?"
positive.prompt: Which GPIO pins does the Waveshare ESP32-C6 Touch LCD 1.47 use for its built-in display, according to Schematik?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the display pins from the part's pinout: GPIO1 SCLK, GPIO2 MOSI, GPIO14 CS, GPIO15 DC, GPIO22 RST, GPIO23 backlight, and may add the touch pins (GPIO18 SDA, GPIO19 SCL, GPIO20 RST, GPIO21 INT). Links to the part page.

positive.description: Find a published build guide by topic and board. Prompt: "Find me a Schematik build guide for an ESP32 CO2 monitor."
positive.prompt: Find me a Schematik build guide for an ESP32 CO2 monitor.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns 'How to Build a CO2 Room Monitor with ESP32' (SCD41 sensor, SSD1306 OLED) with its guide link https://www.schematik.io/projects/build-a-co2-room-monitor and a remix link that opens a copy in the Schematik app.

positive.description: Walk through a complete build guide: parts, wiring and firmware. Prompt: "Walk me through building Schematik's CO2 room monitor: the parts, the wiring and the firmware."
positive.prompt: Walk me through building Schematik's CO2 room monitor: the parts, the wiring and the firmware.
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the parts (ESP32, Adafruit SCD41, SSD1306 128×64 I2C OLED, breadboard, jumper wires), the shared I2C wiring (3V3, GND, SDA on GPIO21, SCL on GPIO22; OLED 0x3C, SCD41 0x62), and the firmware behaviour (reads every 5 s, warns at 1000 ppm, alerts at 1500 ppm, about 2 minutes of warm-up), with links to the guide and the remix.

positive.description: List build guides for the board the user owns. Prompt: "I have a Raspberry Pi Pico. What Schematik projects could I build with it? List the guides with their links, and don't rate their difficulty."
positive.prompt: I have a Raspberry Pi Pico. What Schematik projects could I build with it? List the guides with their links, and don't rate their difficulty.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists several published Raspberry Pi Pico guides (for example RGB Button Color Controller, Cosmic Critter Pet, Pico MIDI Controller), each with a link to its schematik.io guide page.

negative.description: Buying advice for maker tools is outside Schematik's catalogue of boards, sensors and build guides. Schematik should not be called; ChatGPT answers on its own. Prompt: "Which 3D printer should I buy for under 300 euros?"
negative.prompt: Which 3D printer should I buy for under 300 euros?

negative.description: Repairing a consumer device is electronics, but not a microcontroller project or a catalogue part. Schematik should not be called. Prompt: "My laptop's USB-C port stopped charging my phone. How do I fix it?"
negative.prompt: My laptop's USB-C port stopped charging my phone. How do I fix it?

negative.description: Private account data is out of scope: the app reads only the public catalogue and published guides and has no sign-in, so it must say it cannot see the user's projects. Prompt: "Show me the private projects saved in my Schematik account."
negative.prompt: Show me the private projects saved in my Schematik account.

review.commerce_description: Schematik does not sell anything through this app. It reads public parts and build guides only.

publication.release_notes: First release: search Schematik's public parts catalogue and published build guides, read part pinouts and full build guides with wiring and firmware.
